name: secret-mask
description: Masks secrets in tool output before the model sees them and restores them when the model uses the placeholder in a tool call.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Mask secrets in new sessions. /secret-mask on|off overrides it for a session.

restoreIntoFiles.title: Restore into files
restoreIntoFiles.description: Also restore placeholders into Write, Edit and NotebookEdit content, which writes the real secret into the file.

restoreInMcp.title: Restore into MCP arguments
restoreInMcp.description: Also restore placeholders into MCP tool arguments.

patternsFile.title: Patterns file
patternsFile.description: JSON file of your own patterns and allow-list, outside any repository. A leading ~ is your home directory.

refuseSecretMentions.title: Refuse secret @-mentions
refuseSecretMentions.description: While masking is on, refuse an @-mention of a text file that holds a detectable secret (Claude Code keeps an @-mentioned file raw on disk). Read it with a tool instead.
